entities.name: Topos
entities.description: The dream realm of Ixidor made real in central Otaria, which faded when Karona took magic from Dominaria.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Exiled illusionist who imagined Topos and was eaten by a death wurm.

entities.name: Locus
entities.description: Ixidor's impossible palace in Topos, damaged by the death wurm and later collapsed.

entities.name: Greenglades
entities.description: Woodland created by Ixidor in Topos.

entities.name: Shadow Mountains
entities.description: Curling mountains that gave Topos shade.

entities.name: Purity River
entities.description: River created by Ixidor that flowed across Topos.

entities.name: Nightmare Lands
entities.description: Twisted desert landscape formed by Ixidor's darkest magics during the Nightmare War.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Born from Ixidor's dreams; ruled Topos reluctantly and was consumed by the death wurm.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: War in which attackers from Krosa and the Cabal tried to kill Akroma.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Attacker from whom Ixidor's sprite conjured an endless swarm of cockroaches, then death wurms.

entities.name: Nivea
entities.description: Person whose death the prime death worm represented.

entities.name: Stonebrow
entities.description: Left in charge of Topos by Akroma, then left for Sanctum.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Goddess whose departure took all magic from Dominaria.

events.summary: Exiled Ixidor imagines an oasis and builds Topos, then Akroma is born from his dreams.
events.quote: The exiled Ixidor imagined the oasis out of a mirage in thirst and desperation.

events.summary: In the Nightmare War, attackers charge Topos to kill Akroma; Ixidor creates sprites that conjure nightmares.
events.quote: Ixidor stopped them by creating disciples, tiny light-sprites that could enter their opponents' minds and create their worst nightmares.

events.summary: The prime death worm, representing Nivea's death, rampages through Topos, destroys much of Locus and consumes Ixidor.
events.quote: it locked onto Ixidor as its target, rampaging through Topos and destroying much of Locus before it caught up to the illusionist and consumed him.

events.summary: Akroma follows the death wurm to its hiding hole and is consumed, leaving Stonebrow in charge.
events.quote: she followed it and was in turn consumed by it, leaving Stonebrow in charge of Topos until Akroma returned.

events.summary: Akroma leaves to kill Phage, a battle that causes the Rebirth of Karona.
events.quote: Akroma marshaled her forces and left to kill Phage, a battle that caused the Rebirth of Karona .

events.summary: When Karona takes all magic from Dominaria, Topos decays and returns to sand.
events.quote: All of Topos returned to the sands that had birthed it

relations.quote: Topos was the dream realm of Ixidor made reality in central Otaria
the realm saw the birth of Akroma from the illusionist's dreams
